actions.why: A lane leaves the Mese just outside the Founder's gate and climbs north along the wall.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

actions.why: Grown sons with nowhere to sleep and the families still coming off the grain ships build outside the Founder's wall, along the Mese and the new lane, where the Arians already walk on feast days.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

actions.why: A stepped lane from the Mese straight up the middle of the hill, so a carrier no longer threads between houses with a full jar.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

actions.why: The water-carriers' first cistern (AF 54) sits at the foot of the hill and the queue there runs till dark; the families of the upper slope pool their coppers again for a second cistern at the head of the new steps.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

structure.name: House of the Widows and Orphans
structure.label: Widows' house

actions.why: On the hill one household in seven has no grown man left and small children at home. Neighbours and the monks who took in their sons build a house where widows bake for the street and orphans learn a trade.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

actions.why: For ten years the Arians of the hill have prayed in a timber yard beyond the wall, and their priests will not come into the city even to bless a sick child. They raise a small brick church outside the Founder's gate.
actions.source: Liu-line residents' petition (commoners of the Xerolophos); evidence: anthousa-liuzhijie drafts/proposals_af61_70

rejected.reason: no road within 25 units; nobody could reach it
rejected.fix: the Carriers' Steps are listed before the cistern, so the lane exists when the cistern is judged
